name: Azuma Komari
source:
She is more observant than her older sister, but in the end uses that only for malicious pranks and quarrels. She shares the same tyrannical nature with her sister, Himari.

[Translated from the [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/17th/seidorei2/]official site[/url]]
